feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 12 November 2026 10:15pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 12 November 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure over Scandinavia and high pressure to the northwest of Ireland extending a ridge across the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

North or northwest 4 or 5, decreasing force 3 in places overnight, backing west or northwest 3 or 4 tomorrow morning, backing west or southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the west at first.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then occasional showers soon developing. These showers becoming isolated later.


##Visibility##

Good, perhaps falling moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, backing south or southwest 5 or 6 Saturday morning, increasing 7 in the west later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate on Saturday morning and occasionally rough in the west later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then rain in the west later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.
